payload.prompt:
Our little Phoenix business, Xamblepaw Photos, celebrates the pets who somehow occupy three cushions despite weighing next to nothing. For the Super Bowl on Sunday, February 14, 2027, we're running Couch Captain, a free photo contest for those very accomplished sofa companions. The winning photo gets a spot on our homepage, chosen by our panel for the most expressive pose.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "Xamblepaw Photos is our Phoenix-based home for the free Couch Captain pet photo contest, celebrating Super Bowl sofa companions. Pet owners across the United States who are 21 or older may enter under our contest eligibility policy. Upload one original photo of your pet's coziest couch pose by February 15, 2027, for free. Our panel will choose the most expressive pose to feature on our homepage."

Please send people to https://xamblepawphotos.com/couch-captain. We want as many completed contest entries as possible; entries are what we count. Our site has X's pixel, and each successfully submitted entry is reported to X as "Photo entered".

Run the campaign from Thursday, February 11, 2027 through Monday, February 15, 2027, inclusive: five days in the account's time zone, Arizona time. You can launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Please keep watching it throughout the flight, and when it ends, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. We're excited to meet the household's actual couch captains.

Total budget: 650.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
